name: pointspeak
description: Agent-ready visual briefings for coding agents

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pointspeak/schema && npm run build -w @pointspeak/annotator && npm run build -w @pointspeak/capture-core && npm run build -w @pointspeak/handoff && npm run build -w @pointspeak/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pointspeak/schema && npm run typecheck -w @pointspeak/annotator && npm run typecheck -w @pointspeak/capture-core && npm run typecheck -w @pointspeak/handoff && npm run typecheck -w @pointspeak/extension
